assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only yuru-camp:shima-rin@manga#reviewed-synthesis-document02, the active_provisional full-series character synthesis 02_SHIMA_RIN_CHARACTER_VOICE_SOLITUDE_AND_RELATIONSHIPS.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V19, with its 26 claim routes (122 PRIMARY_VERIFIED and 22 ANALYSIS_EXTRACTED records in the project register) taken as the synthesis reports them. assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: From the V01 first encounter with Nadeshiko Kagamihara through the V19 Suwa arrival and the household reunion, organized by the project checkpoints CP03-CP18 and the V19 transaction; the V16 spring-break special is dated before Golden Week. assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The synthesis states a constrained thesis (Shima Rin values self-directed activity, can value particular company and increasingly acts to secure both, within material bounds) and rejects four rivals with located counterexamples: the socialization arc (early initiative, continuing solo evidence), unchanged independence (direct requests, accepted group camps), flawless prudence (V08 relay correction, distance underestimate) and perfectly nonintrusive care (V07 covert check). This is well-argued specialist interpretation. No decision rule, conditional policy or default state is given, and the document says it is not a model certified to generate Rin in new situations, so B is not supported.

Development is ordered across located transitions: the V03 shift from それは遠慮しとく to 考えとく, V04 group participation, the V05 solitude that includes loneliness after group experience, the V09 return affect and reciprocal worry, the V16 sent request to ride with Ayano Toki, the V18-V19 tour, refusals and Suwa. Checkpoints CP03-CP18 are named with their exits, and the V16 special is placed before Golden Week. The states are narrative phases rather than selectable states with exclusions, and the 22 analysis-extracted records keep some middle-volume transitions (V10, V13-V15) at analytical strength.

Located Japanese forms with function and recipient: ラーメン食べる？ to a stranger, いや 食えよ as familiar comic correction, それは遠慮しとく and 考えとく as boundary and opening, そうだな in shared quiet, 犬山さんごちそうさま to Aoi Inuyama, 別に… against a private wish, 人によるかも and 興味あるなら to the junior Ema, お世話になります to Nadeshiko's grandmother, 私も一緒に走りに行っていい？ as a sent request, and polite self-identification to her employer. The synthesis supports recipient- and medium-sensitive register but states that self-reference and address distributions are not exhaustive and that voice in sustained conflict, ethical deliberation, romance and unfamiliar adult interaction is not established. Above Ikumi Mito's E for breadth across volumes and recipients; below C because it is a selected sample, not a register inventory.

The richest dimension: located camping and touring practice (site setup, meals including the V19 hayashi division of steps, fuel errand, charcoal and route failures, laundry, dawn walk), money (¥1,290 against ¥3,800 eel in V05, saving for the next camp, the unaffordable compact tent in V18), equipment upgrades with family hands separated (V08), the haircut (V16), the bookshop call, the Shiba recorded at eight-times zoom (V18), and the reported reading habit. Competence and error coexist. The synthesis says school performance, a full working day, wider reading tastes and noncamp domestic routines are thin, so B is not supported outside camping and touring.

Relations are differentiated by history and mode: Nadeshiko (accumulated practice, covert V07 check, reciprocal V09 worry, the V16-V18 separate-plans agreement as Rin's report, the V19 dinner revision), Ena Saitō (older ease, mediation without acting for her, invented-origin play, sharp correction), Chiaki Ōgaki (practical trust without equal intimacy), Aoi (received thanks and photo contact), Ema (conditional advice), Ayano (a chosen travelling relation with refusals both ways) and the family (separate hands and changing knowledge). Chiaki and Aoi ties rest partly on analysis-extracted records, and no rule predicts conduct toward an unfamiliar recipient.

Private text is separated from disclosure: the V09 少し寂しい is internal and not a confession; the V06 restrained 別に… contrasts with an emphatic private wish Ena can only partly read; the V05 positive solitude includes loneliness. The synthesis repeatedly says silence and scenic panels license no invented thoughts. Substantial located inference without an interior model.

Established locally: refusal of the group camp (V03), of Toba's alcohol request as underage (V04), and of the extra Hamamatsu leg (V19), sustaining the Route 152 preference against Ayano's easier route (V18), and blunt correction of Ena. The synthesis states that her voice in sustained conflict is not established; no interpersonal conflict episode is analyzed. Suitable for bounded canon questions only.

Located acts with an ethical dimension are few: the V04 underage refusal, the V07 covert monitoring that the synthesis says is care without demonstrated consent, and the V18 album visit in which Rin is not given her grandfather's private memory of Saki's prohibition. The synthesis states her voice in ethical deliberation is not established, and the discovery row does not enroll ETHICS for this subject.

Located play: いや 食えよ, the invented friendship-origin stories with Ena and their retraction (V12 bonus), rejection of the imagined haircut reactions, jokes during shared rest and repeating ゼロジバ on the ride, and mock disapproval. The synthesis notes that a reaction panel may serve comic timing rather than character interior. A described repertoire, not a model of when Rin plays.

Coverage spans V01-V19 through 26 routes to exact CBZ raw images and EPUB spines, with 122 primary-verified and 22 analysis-extracted records kept distinct and correction overlays named. The synthesis states that it does not claim another full nineteen-volume primary reread, that the 22 extracted records were not upgraded, and that V19 is not the series' ending; several middle-volume itineraries remain at analytical strength.

Affirmative limits are located: route and travel misjudgment (V03), the V08 relay problem, the missed warning email and sixty-kilometre backtrack, the unreached pond, the underestimated dawn-walk distance and apology, unnoticed eating, the expedient rockfall hedge, the unaffordable tent, the failed Shiba approach and the covert V07 check. Four rival readings are rejected by named counterexamples. Each case rests on one active_provisional synthesis without an independent audit.

Knowledge is staged in time (Rin newly learns at V08 dinner that her mother rode and sees the album at V18; Ayano's tower-removal report is revised by Nadeshiko at V19), the V16 special is dated before Golden Week, and checkpoint boundaries are named. No cutoff-indexed state with exclusions or default state is supplied, so it fixes periods and knowledge order rather than exact retrieval points.

scenario_readiness.note: The synthesis gives a situated linguistic reference with deliberately incomplete distribution and rejects gathering short lines into a context-free speech template. Lines generated beyond the attested forms would be fluent invention rather than source-supported voice. This bounds the evidence set, not Rin's actual speech.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any V01-V19 period the synthesis describes; no post-V19 state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Any counterpart, including Nadeshiko, Ena, Ayano and the Shima family as the synthesis describes them; the refusal does not depend on the partner.
setting_constraints: Crossover, counterfactual or materially novel contexts beyond the located V01-V19 episodes
Behavioral or dialogue simulation rather than bounded canon description

scenario_readiness.note: The synthesis describes itself as a provisional character reference rather than a model certified to generate Rin in new situations, and it supplies no default state or conditional rules for a novel context.

Camping, touring, meal and family-visit conduct is richly located and answers bounded canon questions, but the synthesis warns against predicting an identical interior reaction whenever she is alone and gives no procedure for an unfamiliar ordinary scene; noncamp routines are thin.
The synthesis states her voice in ethical deliberation is not established, and only a few located acts carry an ethical dimension.

The synthesis states that the Suwa friendship facts establish no romance or exclusivity and that her voice in romance is not established. No romantic relation is in evidence; this is not evidence about Rin's capacity for one.

Work appears through the V05 holiday schedule (employer unspecified after the ER-003 correction) and one V16 bookshop telephone call; the synthesis states that wages, duties, savings and occupational ambitions are not supplied.

known_limits.statement: The synthesis is a provisional character reference under architecture section 7, Document 02, not a complete psychology or a model certified to generate Rin in new situations; it explicitly assigns no reconstruction-readiness grade.

Twenty-two older ANALYSIS_EXTRACTED records keep their original verification limit, including several broad itinerary, modular-trip and late solo-camp clusters and the V10 and V13-V15 bridges, and were not upgraded because later evidence resembles them.

The solitude preference recurs but the feeling attached to each occasion is not fixed; 'Rin likes solitude' does not predict an identical interior reaction whenever she is alone, and a little sadness does not invalidate a chosen solo interval.
Rin's care includes the covert V07 check on Nadeshiko, which the synthesis treats as unilateral judgment whose benevolent motive is an interpretation, not proof of consent.
Self-reference and address distributions are not exhaustive, and school, a full working day, wider reading and noncamp domestic routines have bounded samples rather than coverage.

The synthesis states that its samples were available during preparation and are not held-out tests, that V19 is no claim about the manga's ending, and that no later source was consulted for the V18 calendar, the V19 dream seam or the camper pair's names.

The deep readings, checkpoints, five ledgers, correction overlays and the project reconstruction specification are not curated evidence on this subject, so the routed warrants were not rechecked here. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
